text:
I would speak of you so highly
that the world might see what I see in you,
if speech could match desire.

Even if I searched the fairest heavens,
among all precious, lovely things on earth,
I find none that resembles you by a hair;
no one is to blame for not daring to compare.

White things, crystal, gold, and roses,
rubies, pearls, and snow,
compared with your face,
are painted things beside the living.

Before you the stars,
as before the sun, are less beautiful.
The sun is more radiant,
but to my eyes not so lovely.
What can I say, when all I see
is ugly beside you?

Change your name, then, my lady:
call yourself Beauty, Beauty Maria.

translation.title: I Would Speak of You So Highly
translation.editorial_note: Imported as a translation without separate editorial review.
